_doc: Production configuration. Fill in REQUIRED fields before deployment. All other fields have battle-tested defaults.
_score_threshold_doc: Minimum score (0-100) required to open a trade. Raise to 80 for higher precision, lower to 70 for more signals.
_daily_max_trades_doc: Hard cap on total new signals per calendar day (UTC). Prevents overtrading.
_daily_loss_limit_pct_doc: Circuit breaker: halt new signals if daily realized loss exceeds this % of account equity. Set 0 to disable.
_risk_doc: Position sizing suggestion percentages shown in entry messages. Actual order sizing is manual or via your OKX account.
_win_rate_guardian_min_trades_doc: Guardian only activates after this many completed trades (avoid noise in early sample).
_win_rate_guardian_threshold_doc: If rolling win rate drops below this, new signals require score ≥ score_threshold + 5 (extra caution mode).
_session_wr_filter_doc: Boost/penalise score based on historical win rate for the current trading session (Asia/London/NY).
_weekly_trend_doc: Applies -12 pts to any signal trading against the weekly Supertrend direction. Strongly discourages counter-trend trades.
_correlation_filter_doc: Blocks opening a 3rd position in the same asset category (BTC/ETH/alts) to limit correlated exposure.
_tp_ratios_doc: ATR multiples for TP1 / TP2 / TP3 from entry. Tuned for 30min swing trades.
_sl_atr_doc: ATR multiple for initial stop loss placement.
_breakeven_doc: Move stop loss to entry price once TP1 is hit (risk-free trade).
_daily_report_doc: Sends daily performance summary to Telegram at this UTC time. Handled by Cowork scheduled task.
_monthly_report_doc: Sends monthly performance summary. Fires on last day of month (28-31 check).
_lookback_doc: Number of historical candles fetched per symbol per cycle for indicator calculation.
_pivot_type_doc: Pivot point style for S/R levels. Options: classic | camarilla | woodie
_mtf_doc: Timeframes used for Supertrend alignment check. All three must align for maximum score.
_knn_doc: K-Nearest Neighbour similarity learning. Compares current market fingerprint to historical signals.
_post_mortem_doc: After each closed trade, attributes outcome to one of 6 failure/success categories for long-term learning.
_soft_loss_streak_doc: After N consecutive losses, add +5 to required score threshold (caution mode).
_hard_loss_streak_doc: After N consecutive losses, pause new signals for pause_minutes_hard minutes.
_monitor_mode_doc: How TP/SL is monitored. Options: websocket (real-time, recommended) | polling (cron every 1 min)
_proximity_alert_pct_doc: Send a proximity alert when price is within this % of a TP or SL level.
_log_level_doc: Logging verbosity. Options: DEBUG | INFO | WARNING | ERROR
_dry_run_doc: When true, signals are calculated and logged but NO Telegram messages are sent. Use for testing.
